name: claude-constitution-layer-kit
description: The constitution kit: a portable governance layer for Claude Code projects, one plugin per module

plugins.name: const-catalogs
plugins.description: Numbered kinds: a catalogued document's file name and id are one name, <prefix>-<nnnn>-<slug>. A new item's number must be free, and no two items of a catalog share one. Catalogs are declared in this module's own dial. Plus a skill for taking a number, renumbering after a collision, listing and citing.

plugins.name: const-change-cost
plugins.description: Tokens per commit: for every commit a Claude Code session makes, the tokens that session spent on it. They are input, output, cache write and cache read, with their total and list cost. A pinned ccusage counts them from the session's own transcripts. They are kept in the clone, and shared by merge trailer, pull request and git notes.

plugins.name: const-decision-records
plugins.description: Write-time gate on decision records: a document governed by a record policy carries type task-record, stakes (process | product | architecture) and a decider. Plus skills for pricing and recording a decision, and for promoting recurring commit notes.

plugins.name: const-doc-budgets
plugins.description: A character ceiling per group of documents, measured after every write and in a scan. Each ceiling names its documents by path patterns, its number and the days of data it was set from. It warns until 30 days of data stand behind it. A history report over git gives those data. A document that must stand over its ceiling is declared as a departure in the dials file. Plus a skill for setting a ceiling and reading a finding.

plugins.name: const-interaction
plugins.description: Answer in the shape the question has, the answer first. List every assumption, and make every list item addressable. Put honesty over agreement. Stop before a hard-to-reverse act and wait for a yes, with a gate on listed destructive commands.

plugins.name: const-language
plugins.description: Plain prose in governed documents, checked by Vale after every write and in a scan. The check holds a Flesch–Kincaid grade ceiling and a words-per-sentence limit. It reports idioms and formal phrases plain language avoids, formal words with a plain replacement, and passive voice. Every threshold and level is a dial. A departure is declared in the dials file and never marked in the document. Plus a skill that applies the rules while writing and reads a finding.

plugins.name: const-locations
plugins.description: Documents born in their canonical home. A command derives the home from the policy's territory and proves it resolves to exactly that policy. It writes the document from the kind's template with a valid envelope. It comes with a skill for creating documents through it, and one for introducing a new kind — policy first, then territory, then document.

plugins.name: const-meta-types
plugins.description: Write-time guard of claimed territory: every Markdown document there carries the envelope (id, type, title, status) and resolves to exactly one governing policy. Plus a skill for choosing the meta-type.

plugins.name: const-questions
plugins.description: Ask only at recorded stakes or at a genuine blocker; else decide and note. One decision per message, in a fixed shape printed at every session start: lettered options with pros and cons, one recommendation, the decider named. Questions come from open slots, closed vocabularies are the options, defaults take an override, and vague input is restated. No open question inside a deliverable, with a gate on open-question markers in delivered documents.

plugins.name: const-referencing
plugins.description: References a machine can follow and a move can repair. Each kind of reference has one written form, and anchors do not depend on a heading's words. A check reads the whole tree after every write and in the scan, and a mover repairs the links a move breaks. Plus a skill for citing, anchoring and moving, and two always-on sentences about references in chat.

plugins.name: const-styling
plugins.description: One style guide every governed document follows: diagrams, prose against lists and tables, list and table format, headings, code blocks, emphasis, callouts. Departures are declared per territory or per document in the dials file, with a reason. A scan reports the traces of the defaults that no departure allows. Plus a skill that applies the defaults before a diagram, a table, a formula or a template is written.

plugins.name: const-task-close
plugins.description: Task close as a single act. A change that touches code covered by current-state documents updates them or declares no impact. A close procedure merges deltas, deletes working files and sets the record inactive. At turn end, a dirty tree gets a warning or a block.
